title: PARALLAX counterfactual twins and DREAMSTATE policy incubator integrated
summary: PARALLAX provides immutable observed counterfactual decision/branch evidence, regret and paired ablation attribution; DREAMSTATE converts statistically screened patterns into bounded, versioned shadow candidates behind the Adaptive Brain protected validation gates. One active candidate per family and a 12-trial family budget constrain research multiplicity. Exact code provenance is fail-closed and accepted outcomes automatically re-screen DREAMSTATE. The trader UI exposes both systems and all authority remains research/shadow only.
evidence: Exact clean-code provenance fallback for PARALLAX decisions
Automatic DREAMSTATE rescreen after accepted PARALLAX outcomes
